title: Korean-Style Taco Fiesta
description: A fusion twist on traditional tacos, with a spicy Korean kick. Enjoy this flavorful and easy-to-make recipe for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Bouncy Beef (or tofu for vegetarian)
ingredients.notes: Cook at 160°F for 20 minutes to ensure food safety

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the Bouncy Beef with a pinch of Korean Chili Flakes.
Grill or cook the beef for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches a safe internal temperature of 160°F.
Warm the Jazzy Jumbo Corn Tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of Taco Corn and a dollop of your favorite taco toppings.
